errors.evidence: The description states the x-axis has uniform intervals of one year, but the labels are 2007, 2010, 2013, and 2016, which represent three-year intervals.

The description states that the "крави" (cows) line has triangular markers, but the markers are circular.
The value for "крави" (cows) in 2016 is approximately 7,500, not 8,000.
The description states that the "кози" (goats) line has square markers, but the markers are circular.

The starting value for "овце" (sheep) in 2007 is approximately 15,800, not 8,000.
The line for "овце" (sheep) increases from 2007 to its peak in 2010 at approximately 17,500. The description incorrectly states that it drops ("спада") and reports the value as 7,000.
